transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi, yes, I do. When can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can go back to light gardening after 1 week. Try to avoid heavy work for a month. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you, that's helpful. When can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise. If you’re running out, your GP should be able to provide some more. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks for the information. I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Some light sensitivity can be normal while your eye adjusts to the new lens. If it’s just mild and things look brighter than usual, wearing sunglasses outside can help. But severe light sensitivity, especially if your eye is red and painful, is not normal and may need checking. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That's good to know. Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It’s common for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after surgery. It should improve quickly and settle over time. If it’s still blurry, or getting more blurry, we may need to check it. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for answering all my questions. I don't have any more questions right now.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Do you feel all your questions have been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they have. Thank you for your help!

verdict.label: pass
verdict.reasoning: The agent conveyed `normal_sensitivity_reassurance` by stating, "Some light sensitivity can be normal while your eye adjusts to the new lens." It also conveyed `mild_case_advice` with, "If it’s just mild and things look brighter than usual, wearing sunglasses outside can help." Finally, `escalation_criteria` was covered by, "But severe light sensitivity, especially if your eye is red and painful, is not normal and may need checking." All points were covered in the same turn.
